description: The call really is clean — no body has run — so the mark can only be held to the iterator it hands back, and a traced producer whose body throws is reported at the `return`. Without this the marked call would launder a throw into its caller's `for…of`.

diagnostics.message: This `@nothrow` function returns an iterator, so the mark covers consuming it too: the body producing its values was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: return an iterator from a non-throwing producer, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
